title: Uptown versus downtown rivalry
summary: Groups from uptown and downtown used to be rivals, and he never played the Big 25s.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: You said about uptown and downtown. Was there always the same between the two groups?

Down, yeah, uh-huh. Yeah, uh-huh. Well, that's the way some people feel about it. I mean, a guy live way downtown, a guy live uptown. I mean, he has his group and the guy down in town have his group, you know? Uh-huh. Tell me that a long time ago, years ago, I mean, like if you live way downtown and you couldn't go uptown, you couldn't hardly go up there. This guy would tear you up. It's not like that now. Yeah. Did you ever play around the big 25s or beat-luck? No, I heard of that. That was before my time. 25. That was before my time. I heard it at 25.
